title: Zephyr: link-local from IID
notes: Implemented alias-safe Zephyr link-local construction: lichen_make_link_local snapshots the 8-byte IID before writing fe80::/64, so IID input may alias either half of struct in6_addr. Added direct byte-exact vectors from ipv6-addresses.json shapes, verified U/L-set IIDs are copied without a second mutation, tested leading/trailing aliases, and asserted NULL IID leaves output unchanged. Validation: host C/UBSan CMake build + CTest pubkey_to_iid 1/1; Python cross-implementation address vectors 7/7; Rust ipv6_address_vectors 4/4. Native 0200::/8 behavior and short_addr_iid untouched.
